intromsq1_001.desc: Our mass budget is tight! Do we book NASA's Space Launch System (SLS) for crew comfort, or a heavy cargo rocket for extra armor?

right.desc: Launch on SLS Block 1B with full crew quarters.

left.desc: Cram the crew into a heavy cargo lander.

intromsq1_002.desc: We can dock at the Lunar Gateway station in a wide halo orbit for resupplies, or dive straight into Low Lunar Orbit to save fuel.

right.desc: Dock at Gateway for extra food and comms.

left.desc: Burn straight for Low Lunar Orbit to save power.

intromsq1_003.desc: Touch down on Shackleton Crater's sunny South Pole rim for constant solar power, or inside a basalt lava tube for natural shielding?

right.desc: Land on Shackleton's sunny South Pole ridge.

left.desc: Land inside the armored Mare Lava Tube pit.

intromsq1_004.desc: Our lander only has room for one heavy module! Pack a Kilopower nuclear reactor, or an expanded Veggie hydroponic farm?

right.desc: Pack the Kilopower nuclear fission core.

left.desc: Pack the expanded Veggie hydroponic greenhouse.

intromsq1_005.desc: Touchdown confirmed! For our final payload bay, do we activate the NASA Rover homing beacon, or the deep-space SETI dish?

right.desc: Ping NASA's lost VIPER rover nearby!

left.desc: Fire up the deep-space SETI radio dish!

upgrademsq2_001_start.desc: Lunar Gateway just dropped a heavy orbital upgrade module! Do we build the Anti-Meteor Defense Grid, or the Bio-Dome & Oxygen Control Core?

right.desc: Construct the Anti-Meteor Laser Turret & Shield Grid.

left.desc: Build the Pressurized Bio-Dome & Oxygen Control Core.

upgrademsq2_002_security.desc: We're mounting automated Whipple shields and laser turrets on the roof to vaporize incoming micrometeorites!

right.desc: Link the turrets to orbital tracking radar for max accuracy.

left.desc: Install solar-capacitor banks on the turret barrels.

upgrademsq2_002_lifesupport.desc: We're replacing our old air valves with triple-redundant Kevlar oxygen tanks and automated pressure regulators!

right.desc: Enrich the cabin air mix for peak crew health and focus.

left.desc: Route spare liquid oxygen to boost the fuel cells.

upgrademsq2_003_security.desc: The anti-meteor turrets are online! Now we're wiring a superconducting magnetic dome to deflect cosmic radiation.

right.desc: Tune the magnetic field to double as a radiation bunker.

left.desc: Harvest solar-wind ions from the shield for free power.

upgrademsq2_003_lifesupport.desc: With the oxygen tanks secured, we're inflating a sunlit hydroponic Bio-Dome filled with air-scrubbing orchard trees!

right.desc: Plant high-calorie dwarf fruit trees and berry vines.

left.desc: Add therapeutic park benches and UV sunlamps for the crew.

upgrademsq2_004_security.desc: Aegis Defense Network Complete! A meteor storm approaches, and our automated laser turrets blast the space rocks into harmless metallic dust!

right.desc: Scoop up the vaporized meteor iron to reinforce the hull!

left.desc: Throw a crew viewing party under the invincible dome!

upgrademsq2_004_lifesupport.desc: Oasis Core Complete! The Bio-Dome and smart oxygen tanks are running in a 100% closed loop—fresh breeze and ripe harvests fill the base!

right.desc: Feast on fresh Bio-Dome produce and pure mountain air!

left.desc: Store excess liquid oxygen and biofuel for emergencies!

upgrademsq2_visit_security.desc: Pew-pew! The Aegis anti-meteor turrets just sniped another stray asteroid chunk out of the sky, and the magnetic shield is humming smoothly!

right.desc: Smelt the asteroid fragments into fresh hull plating!

left.desc: Siphon excess capacitor energy straight into the base grid!

upgrademsq2_visit_lifesupport.desc: Breathe easy! The Bio-Dome orchards just hit peak harvest, and the smart oxygen tanks report 100% pure air pressure across all habitats!

right.desc: Serve fresh orchard fruit and boost cabin oxygen!

left.desc: Vent spare oxygen into the fuel cells for clean energy!

explosionmsq3_001_start.desc: BANG! Because we skipped the Life Support upgrade, an aging Apollo-style cryo-oxygen tank just shorted out and blew open Habitat B!

right.desc: Slam the blast doors and vent the burning bay!

left.desc: Send emergency crews into the flames with foam!

explosionmsq3_002.desc: Toxic smoke is flooding the air ducts! Like Apollo 13, CO2 is spiking fast and our round lithium-hydroxide scrubbers don't fit the backup slots!

right.desc: Duct-tape spacesuit hoses to jury-rig a filter!

left.desc: Overclock the greenhouse fans to scrub the air!

explosionmsq3_003.desc: Shrapnel from the oxygen blast punctured our thermal cooling loop! Ammonia coolant is boiling into cabin vapor and overheating the mainframes.

right.desc: Cut secondary power grids and freeze the leak!

left.desc: Flush the cooling pipes with emergency water!

explosionmsq3_004.desc: The fire is out and air pressure is holding! Using NASA epoxy patch kits, the crew bolts an armored bulkhead over the ruptured wall.

right.desc: Crack open emergency oxygen reserves for the crew!

left.desc: Salvage the wrecked tank into hull armor and wire!

meteorshowermsq3_001_start.desc: SIREN ALERT! Because we skipped the Defense Grid, a hypervelocity Taurid meteoroid swarm is slamming into the unshielded base at 65,000 mph!

right.desc: Drop internal blast shutters and evacuate the rim!

left.desc: Dump all reactor power into emergency magnetic fields!

meteorshowermsq3_002.desc: A marble-sized meteoroid just punched through Solar Array Alpha with the force of dynamite! Live high-voltage cables are arcing across the hull.

right.desc: Fire explosive bolts to sever the shorted solar wing!

left.desc: Send an EVA team into the meteor storm to rewire it!

meteorshowermsq3_003.desc: Micrometeorites shredded the outer Kevlar bladder of the Bio-Dome! Warm air is whistling into the vacuum and our crops are flash-freezing!

right.desc: Inject rapid-curing NASA polymer foam into the holes!

left.desc: Harvest the freezing crops and seal off the outer dome!

meteorshowermsq3_004.desc: The Taurid swarm finally passes! The lunar dust settles around a fresh crater field packed with dense nickel-iron meteorite fragments.

right.desc: Pile lunar regolith sandbags over the battered domes!

left.desc: Smelt the meteor iron to repair the grid and habitats!

upgrademsq4_001_start.desc: Silver lining! The shockwaves from our recent crisis cracked the crater floor, opening a massive subterranean lava tube! How should we remodel the new cavern?

right.desc: Build the Subterranean Helium-3 Fusion Core.

left.desc: Construct the Deep-Crater Agricultural Mega-Vault.

upgrademsq4_002_power.desc: While repairing the blast zone, engineers anchor a magnetic-confinement fusion reactor into the exposed bedrock!

right.desc: Ignite the Helium-3 plasma injector for maximum megawatts!

left.desc: Route reactor waste-heat to warm the crew quarters and farms.

upgrademsq4_002_food.desc: The blast exposed an ancient vein of pure lunar water-ice! We're melting it into an underground reservoir.

right.desc: Flood the vertical aeroponic towers with mineral-rich water!

left.desc: Stock the warm cavern lake with high-protein aquaculture tilapia!

upgrademsq4_003_power.desc: We're replacing the damaged surface cables with zero-resistance superconducting conduits cooled by the freezing cavern walls!

right.desc: Overcharge the colony's main capacitor banks!

left.desc: Channel surplus gigawatts into the orbital defense shields and heaters.

upgrademsq4_003_food.desc: Inside the wide lava tube, we're spinning up centrifuge crop rings that simulate Earth gravity for giant yields!

right.desc: Cultivate dense dwarf-wheat, soybeans, and sweet potatoes!

left.desc: Ferment spare crop biomass into methane fuel for the generators!

upgrademsq4_004_power.desc: Helios-3 Core Complete! What started as disaster repairs is now a subterranean miniature sun, flooding the colony with limitless clean energy!

right.desc: Run all colony systems at 150% capacity!

left.desc: Beam excess microwave power to orbital storage banks!

upgrademsq4_004_food.desc: Demeter Vault Complete! The scarred crater is now a thriving underground biosphere overflowing with golden grain, fresh fish, and fruit!

right.desc: Host a massive five-course harvest banquet for the crew!

left.desc: Freeze-dry ten tons of surplus rations in the deep cavern!

upgrademsq4_visit_power.desc: Thrum-thrum! Deep beneath the repaired hull, the Helium-3 Fusion Core is purring like a cosmic engine, overflowing our superconducting grid with megawatts!

right.desc: Dump surplus fusion energy into the main batteries and shields!

left.desc: Power up the high-intensity grow lamps and crew spas!

upgrademsq4_visit_food.desc: Dinner bell! The subterranean Demeter Vault just rotated another bumper crop of wheat, berries, and fresh tilapia up the cargo elevator!

right.desc: Pack the pantries to the ceiling and treat the crew!

left.desc: Convert surplus bio-oil into high-grade fuel cell energy!

finalemsq5_001_start.desc: Earth's first 100-ton Super-Heavy Cargo Lander is on final approach! Without a solid landing pad, its rocket exhaust will blast lunar dust at 2,000 m/s and shred our base!

right.desc: Fire up NASA's microwave pavers to melt the dirt into a basalt pad!

left.desc: Send the crew out with polymer spray to glue the loose regolith down!

finalemsq5_002.desc: The pad's center is solid, but we need an angled blast berm around the perimeter to deflect the supersonic exhaust plume away from our solar arrays!

right.desc: Pile up sintered regolith bricks into a 10-meter blast wall!

left.desc: Angle the base's magnetic shields to deflect the charged dust cloud!

finalemsq5_003.desc: The cargo lander is dropping through 5,000 meters! Thick plume dust is blinding its optical cameras—if it misses the pad's center, the engines will dig a crater and tip over!

right.desc: Overclock our SPLICE Lidar beacon to cut through the dust cloud!

left.desc: Have our pilot manually guide it down by radar from the airlock!

finalemsq5_004_win.desc: Touchdown confirmed! The sintered basalt pad holds firm against the fiery exhaust! With a permanent Earth-Moon Spaceport online, unlimited supplies pour into the colony!

right.desc: Open the cargo bay and celebrate humanity's permanent lunar home!

left.desc: Launch fireworks from the airlock—our colony is officially self-sustaining!

roversidequest_001_start.desc: NASA's lost VIPER rover rolls up to our airlock, flashing its headlights! Its link to Earth is dead, and its ice-scanner is pinging nearby.

right.desc: Drain our grid to send it ice mining.

left.desc: Send it to the sunny ridge as a scout.

roversidequest_002_ice.desc: VIPER's wheels are sinking into fluffy 'fairy-castle' moon dust inside a dark crater! Spinning the tires will bury its belly pan.

right.desc: Use NASA's 'Inchworm' wheel-lifting crawl.

left.desc: Floor the throttle and yank it out with winches!

roversidequest_002_scout.desc: The rover clipped a rock and ripped off its back fender! Static-charged moon dust is coating its heat mirrors and cooking its circuits.

right.desc: Tape laminated colony maps over the wheel.

left.desc: Drive it into a freezing crater to cool down.

roversidequest_003_ice.desc: At -235°C in the dark crater, VIPER's drill hits rock-hard ice! The drill is straining, and the battery heaters only have 4 hours left.

right.desc: Peck slowly using NASA's 'bite-and-brush' drill rule.

left.desc: Max the drill torque and ignore the battery alarm!

roversidequest_003_scout.desc: Siren alert! NASA satellites spotted a huge Solar Flare heading our way. Radiation on the exposed ridge will fry the rover's computer!

right.desc: Park behind a boulder in NASA 'Safe Mode.'

left.desc: Keep driving through the radiation storm!

roversidequest_004_ice.desc: Jackpot! VIPER dug up 5% pure water-ice and ammonia! It drops off the load at base before heading out on permanent deep-crater patrol.

right.desc: Melt the ice and ammonia for our farms!

left.desc: Split the water into oxygen and rocket fuel!

roversidequest_004_scout.desc: VIPER found a 'Peak of Eternal Light' with 92% year-round sunshine and titanium ore! It sets up a ridge outpost to run solo patrols.

right.desc: Link its new solar tower to our power grid!

left.desc: Bake the titanium dirt into dome armor bricks!

roversidequest_visit_ice.desc: Beep-beep! VIPER is back from its crater patrol, covered in frost and flashing its headlights at the airlock with a fresh load of ice!

right.desc: Refill the greenhouses and clean its camera!

left.desc: Crack the ice for fuel and patch its drill!

roversidequest_visit_scout.desc: Look who's back! VIPER rolls down from the sunny ridge, beaming spare solar power and towing a sled of titanium rocks!

right.desc: Drain its batteries and tune up its wheels!

left.desc: Armor the hull with titanium and send it back!

aliensidequest_001_dip.desc: An alien delegation approaches the perimeter, broadcasting a peaceful mathematical sequence.

right.desc: Welcome them with open arms.

left.desc: Lock down the base and aim weapons.

aliensidequest_001_com.desc: Alien vessels lock weapons onto our primary dome! Our refusal to share resources has provoked an attack.

right.desc: Return fire with everything we have!

left.desc: Beg for mercy and pay tribute.

aliensidequest_002_dip.desc: The alien envoys share either crystalline zero-point energy matrices or bio-seeds in exchange for our peaceful hospitality!

right.desc: Plug their zero-point matrix into our main grid!

left.desc: Plant the alien star-seeds in our hydroponic bays!

aliensidequest_002_com.desc: The alien scout ship crashes into a nearby crater after our laser barrage! Its exotic alloy hull is still smoking.

right.desc: Salvage the alien armor plating for our domes!

left.desc: Siphon the ship's antimatter fuel cells!

aliensidequest_003_war.desc: Smoke drifts off of the colony and the evading alien fleet as shots are exchanged, the sounds of explosions loud in the air. The crew hears them ramping back up to attack again.

right.desc: Ask for a truce...

left.desc: Arm the domes and fight them off!

aliensidequest_003_peace.desc: ALIEN CONTACT [CONCLUSION] — The aliens' ship prepares for lift off, and the alien leader asks for a gift to show our friendship. Which gift should the colony give?

right.desc: Give them a flashdrive with all of Nickelbacks albums on it, and they loved it! They reward us with resources.

left.desc: Demand a gift from them instead. They hand over special batteries!

right.desc: Divert power to the greenhouses.

left.desc: Starve the crew on half-rations.

right.desc: Shut down life support and shields.

left.desc: Let the grid brown out.

main_003.desc: A shallow magnitude 4.5 moonquake is shaking the ground! The habitat domes are groaning as the fault line shifts underneath us.

right.desc: Max out the magnetic shock absorbers.

left.desc: Do nothing and hope the domes hold.

main_004.desc: Our NASA 'Veggie' garden pods are drowning! In low gravity, water forms bubbles around the lettuce roots and suffocates them.

right.desc: Blast the roots with high-power air fans.

left.desc: Feed the rotting greens to the crew.

main_005.desc: Glass-sharp moon dust is sticking to our spacesuits! It's chewing up the airlock seals and giving the crew 'Apollo hay fever.'

right.desc: Zap the suits with electric dust shields.

left.desc: Track the toxic dust inside anyway.

main_006.desc: Our Kilopower nuclear reactor is running hot! We can push the uranium core harder for energy, or cool it down to protect the base.

right.desc: Yank the control rod and disable alarms!

left.desc: Scram the reactor and bury it in dirt.

main_007.desc: A lunar satellite spotted a collapsed lava tube cave two kilometers away! Its thick stone roof offers natural radiation shielding.

right.desc: Winch a rover down to mine volcanic rock.

left.desc: Send astronauts on foot without ropes.

main_008.desc: The life-support water recycler is clogged! Low gravity makes the crew lose bone calcium, and that mineral sludge is jamming our urine filters.

right.desc: Boil the filters clean with spare power.

left.desc: Drink the unfiltered urine to save power.

main_009.desc: Wait—is that Surveyor 3?! A scout found a 1960s NASA probe sitting in a crater, still wrapped in shiny foil and titanium struts.

right.desc: Strip its camera and titanium like Apollo 12.

left.desc: Melt the historic probe down for scrap.

main_010.desc: The Geminid meteor shower is pelting the Moon! With no atmosphere to burn them up, tiny space pebbles are hitting faster than bullets.

right.desc: Drop blast shutters and power the shields.

left.desc: Leave the glass domes and solar panels exposed.

main_011.desc: One of our cube-shaped NASA Astrobee robots went haywire in the cafeteria! Its fans are blowing floating crumbs everywhere while it sings 'Daisy Bell.'

right.desc: Wipe its memory and force it on leak patrol.

left.desc: Smash it with a wrench.

main_012.desc: NASA's Lunar Gateway space station is passing right overhead! They can drop us a supply pod if we guide it down to the landing pad.

right.desc: Burn laser power to guide it down safely.

left.desc: Turn off the beacon and let it crash near base.

main_013.desc: Living in one-sixth gravity is weakening the crew's bones and making their vision blurry! Doctors warn that health is slipping fast.

right.desc: Force 2-hour daily vacuum workouts.

left.desc: Ignore the doctors and work them harder.

main_014.desc: Our moon-dirt smelter is glowing at 1,600°C! Baking lunar soil separates out pure oxygen gas and leaves behind molten iron.

right.desc: Bottle the oxygen for the crew.

left.desc: Dump uncooled molten iron straight onto the hull.

main_015.desc: NASA's deep-space laser dish just locked onto our receiver! We have ultra-fast internet from Earth for the next 20 minutes.

right.desc: Download solar-storm shield patches.

left.desc: Pirate unverified code to overclock the grid.

main_016.desc: Weird pink space-slime is growing inside our cooling pipes! Tough bacteria survived radiation and are blocking water flow to the computers.

right.desc: Boil the pipes and compost the dead slime.

left.desc: Flush the cooling water into space.

main_017.desc: Our Valkyrie humanoid robot froze up while fixing the outer antenna! It's stuck hanging onto the tower as deadly shadow creeps in.

right.desc: Send a rover team into the cold to rescue it.

left.desc: Leave it to freeze and shatter on the tower.

main_018.desc: Our miners scooped up moon dirt packed with Helium-3 from solar wind! The engineers want to test it in our unshielded fusion prototype.

right.desc: Dump raw Helium-3 into the unshielded core!

left.desc: Play it safe: sift the dirt for crop nitrogen.

main_019.desc: We found an old Apollo laser mirror out on the plains! Scientists on Earth still bounce green laser beams off it to measure the Moon's orbit.

right.desc: Use canned air to blow dust off the mirror.

left.desc: Pry the mirror up and blind Earth's lasers.

main_020.desc: The crew in Habitat B has 'space cabin fever,' and the sewage tank is full! NASA research shows human waste is great at blocking cosmic rays.

right.desc: Line the bedroom walls with bagged sewage.

left.desc: Vent the raw sewage right outside the airlock.

main_021.desc: We dug up a pocket of 'Orange Soil'—tiny volcanic glass beads from 3.6 billion years ago, just like Apollo 17 found!

right.desc: Bake the beads at 900°C to extract water.

left.desc: Melt the glass into 3D-printed dome armor.

main_022.desc: The two-week lunar night is at its coldest! It's -248°C outside, and the habitat's outer cooling pipes are about to freeze solid and burst.

right.desc: Kill the greenhouse heat to thaw the pipes.

left.desc: Let the outer pipes freeze and burst!
